narrative.overview:
LifeOS is a calculating machine for one person's records. A grey casing holds paper-white registers under black heads; one signal orange marks the thing to press and anything running; each area has its own keycap. Every derived figure explains itself in the formula bar and every record keeps a History. Desks arrange sheets as tiles, the Journal reads every area's events by day, and saved views name filtered sheets. Millennium reskins the same shell without moving anything.

Derived from the built Flutter shell and its goldens (test/goldens), with synthetic data only.
keyCharacteristics: Grey casing, paper registers, black heads; flat and square.
One orange for action and running state.
Archivo for words; Azeret Mono tabular figures for every number.
Keys with a 2px pressable edge are the only depth.
Formula bar explanations and per-record History.

rules.name: The One-Orange Rule
rules.body: Orange means press this or this is running; never decoration.

rules.name: The Words-First Rule
rules.body: Draft, Void, Running, over and under are always written; colour only supports the word.

rules.name: The Figures-Line-Up Rule
rules.body: Anything compared down a column is set in Figure and right-aligned.

rules.name: The Flat-Casing Rule
rules.body: Regions differ by tone and lines, never by elevation.

dos: Do put every figure in a register and give derived figures an explanation.
Do take colours only from tokens and painting only from the skin's painters.
Do keep keys labelled, targets at least 24×24, and focus distinct from selection.
Do keep routes, view filters and tile references structural.
Do use synthetic data in tests, goldens and screenshots.
donts: Don't add KPI cards, dashboards or a scaled-up tablet layout.
Don't add shadows, blur, glow or gradients to Office Machine.
Don't let a skin move, resize or re-word a control.
Don't signal state by colour alone.
